decisions.reason: A dedicated business unit was set up and publicly announced as a strategic focus on offshore energy and renewables, so the visible investment and alignment with the firm's sustainability direction make it highly likely to be kept.

Travel management grows naturally out of the firm's crew operations and needs little separate investment, but it is not a flagship, so it carries a moderate risk of being folded back into the core business.
The online portal was presented as a flagship of the firm's digital direction and has its own page, so public commitment and sunk development costs favour persisting with it.

The mobile performance app has less public commitment and could be merged into the portal, but its fit with efficiency and sustainability goals and its modest results so far make retention more likely.
